auth.subtitle: Your projects, tasks, notes, and files are encrypted on your device before they reach us. Helvety can't read or recover them. There is no master key or password. You sign in with a one-time email code and unlock your data with a passkey. Helvety Cloud is 100% open source, so you can verify our claims on <github>GitHub</github>.
auth.accountDeletedSubtitle: Your Helvety account and solo-owned workspaces are gone. Helvety cannot recover your data.
auth.oneMoreStep: One more step on your devices
auth.removePasskey: Remove your Helvety Cloud unlock passkey from your password manager or device.
auth.deleteRecovery: Securely delete any <file></file> or other recovery-key backups.
auth.cannotInspectPasskeys: Helvety cannot inspect or remove passkeys stored on your device. Stale credentials cannot restore deleted server data.
auth.billingLimits: Free plan limits are listed in the <billing>Billing terms</billing>.
auth.signInSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a one-time sign-in code.
auth.requestFailed: Auth request failed. Check Supabase Auth logs and SMTP.

shell.newWorkspaceDescription: Creates a new workspace with its own key. The name is encrypted with that key, so Helvety cannot read it.
shell.renameWorkspaceDescription: Updates the display name. Kind (Personal vs standard) cannot change.

legalChrome.title: Legal
legalChrome.indexIntro: Product legal pack for Helvety Cloud, provided by Helvety by Rubin (Basel). You must accept the Terms, Privacy Policy, AUP, and E2EE notice before encryption setup.

unlock.cannotUnlockBody: Your data is encrypted on your device. Helvety cannot decrypt or restore it. If you lose your unlock passkey and offline recovery key, your data is gone permanently.
unlock.recoveryMaterialIntro: Store both the recovery key and the recovery wrap offline. Neither is logged or sent to Helvety. Losing these with your unlock passkey means permanent data loss.
unlock.recoveryKeyCopied: Recovery key copied to clipboard (device only).
unlock.recoveryWrapCopied: Recovery wrap copied to clipboard (device only).
unlock.noKeysYet: No encryption keys yet. Set up encryption first.

policy.title: Accept policies to continue
policy.intro: Acceptance is logged with policy version and timestamp before encryption setup. Open each linked document to read it.
policy.e2eeSuffix: Helvety cannot decrypt or recover your data; lost keys mean permanent loss; I am responsible for my content and keys.

settings.workspaceSettingsDescription: Manage name, members, billing, and deletion for {name}.
settings.workspaceSettingsDescriptionFallback: Manage name, members, billing, and deletion.
settings.projectSettingsDescription: Categorization names are encrypted. Option ids on tasks are plaintext metadata for filtering.
settings.name: Name
settings.membersInviteIntro: Invite by email. After they sign in and set up encryption, complete key handoff on an unlocked device. Helvety never sees the workspace key or your data.
settings.onlyOwnersAdminsInvite: Only owners and admins can invite members.
settings.freePlanSeats: The free plan includes {count} seats per workspace.
settings.onlyOwnerManageBilling: Only the owner can manage billing.
settings.freeOverflowLocked: New creates are paused because this workspace is over the free allowance (two free workspaces per account). Existing content stays available. Upgrade to Pro, or reduce owned free workspaces to unlock creates again.
settings.unmeteredProLimits: Unmetered Pro limits. Helvety cannot decrypt or recover your data.
settings.storageNotIncluded: not included on Free (upgrade to attach files)
settings.onlyOwnerDangerZone: Only the workspace owner can access the danger zone.
settings.personalCannotDelete: Your personal workspace cannot be deleted. It is created with your encryption setup and anchors your account.
settings.deleteWorkspaceWarning: Permanently delete this workspace and all projects, tasks, notes, contacts, files, invitations, and sharing. This cannot be undone. Helvety cannot recover deleted data.
settings.cancelProBeforeDelete: Cancel the Pro subscription in Manage billing before deleting this workspace.
settings.deleteWorkspaceDescription: This permanently deletes the workspace and all projects, tasks, notes, contacts, files, invitations, and sharing. This cannot be undone. Helvety cannot recover deleted data.
settings.signedInAs: Signed in as <email></email>. Auth is email OTP, so there is no account password. Billing is per workspace (owner manages Plan in workspace settings).
settings.deletionBulletAuth: Your auth account, profile, encryption metadata, policy acceptances, and sessions are permanently removed.
settings.deletionBulletSolo: Solo workspaces you own (including Personal) and everything inside them (projects, tasks, notes, contacts, links, ciphertext, and wrapped keys) are permanently deleted. Helvety cannot decrypt or recover your data.
settings.deletionBulletPro: Pro subscriptions on those deleted solo workspaces are cancelled.
settings.deletionBulletShared: Shared workspaces you do not solely own remain. You leave them: your membership and wrapped keys are removed, so you lose access while other members keep the workspace.
settings.deletionBulletInvites: Pending invitations tied to you are removed or cancelled.
settings.cannotDeleteYetBody: You still own shared workspaces with other members. Delete those workspaces from settings before deleting your account. Helvety will not delete shared workspaces for other members.
settings.dangerZonePasskeyCleanup: After deletion, remove your Helvety Cloud unlock passkey from your device or password manager (Apple Passwords, Google Password Manager, Windows Hello, etc.). The site cannot erase it from your device. Also securely delete any downloaded <file></file> or other recovery-key backups. Stale passkeys and recovery files cannot restore deleted server data.
settings.cleanupAck: I understand deletion is permanent, and I will remove my Helvety Cloud unlock passkey from my devices/password managers and destroy any recovery backups after deletion.
settings.deleteAccountDescription: This permanently deletes your account and solo-owned workspaces. Shared workspaces you leave stay for other members. Helvety cannot recover your data. This cannot be undone.
settings.stagesDescription: Required on tasks. Default is used for new tasks and when deleting an in-use stage. Show limits how many tasks appear before “Show more”. % is the stage’s weight toward project completion (Cancelled is excluded).
settings.labelsDescription: Optional on tasks. Delete clears the label on affected tasks.
settings.prioritiesDescription: Required on tasks. Default is used for new tasks and when deleting an in-use priority.
settings.importDescription: Replace this project’s labels, stages, and priorities with a clone from another project. Tasks are remapped by matching option names.
settings.deleteProjectWarning: Permanently delete this project, all of its tasks and milestones, and files on those tasks. Notes and contacts stay in the workspace. This cannot be undone. Helvety cannot recover deleted data.
settings.deleteProjectDescription: This permanently deletes the project, all of its tasks and milestones, and files on those tasks. Notes and contacts stay in the workspace. This cannot be undone.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: Invitations addressed to your signed-in email. Helvety cannot decrypt workspace content; the owner seals the workspace key to your public key on their device.
invitations.unlockRequired: Unlock with your passkey to claim and accept invitations.
invitations.statusWaitingForRecipient: Claim this invitation to share your public key with the owner.
invitations.statusWaitingForOwnerSeal: Waiting for the owner to complete key handoff on their unlocked device.
invitations.statusReadyToAccept: Key handoff is complete. Accept to join the workspace.
